Linz ( / l ɪ n t s / LIHNTS ; [ 1 ] Austrian German: [lɪnts] ⓘ ; Czech : Linec [ˈlɪnɛt͡s] ) is the capital of Upper Austria and third-largest city in Austria . Located on the river Danube , the city is in the far north of Austria, 30 km (19 mi) south of the border with the Czech Republic . As of 1 January 2024, the city has a population of 214,064. [ 2 ] It is the seventh-largest of all cities on the river Danube .
